headline: THE ELECTION OPENS AS VALERIUS'S ESTATE ENTERS A BROADER COMMERCIAL PHASE

events.title: THE ELECTION OPENS AS AN UNEXPECTED BALLOT-RECORD DISPUTE APPEARS ON THE FIRST DAY
events.body: The civic election formally opens, moving Valerius's candidacy from preparation and procedural filing into the active voting period. Voting begins under the established civic procedure, and Valerius's campaign participates through the lawful channels already prepared for it rather than treating the opening as evidence of electoral support. During the first day's proceedings, officials discover that a small group of ballot records has been entered under an inconsistent administrative notation, prompting a formal objection before those records are incorporated into the working count. The officials separate the disputed records for review and correct the notation without publishing a tally or declaring an electoral result. Valerius's representatives accept the procedural ruling and preserve the documentation with the existing campaign archive. No numerical result, endorsement, or prediction emerges from the incident. The material development is that the election has begun, while its first administrative complication has been contained within the civic process rather than becoming an electoral outcome.

background_sources.source: political correspondence maintained by Valerius's household
background_sources.basis: independent background civic intelligence; not caused by the ballot-record dispute

classification_audit.causal_basis: Unexpected but causally plausible development emerging from the opening of the established election process; preserved as Surprise after the Ultimate Reclassification Gate.

events.title: VALERIUS FORMALLY GRANTS THE NEW HOUSEHOLD REGULAR TENANT STATUS
events.body: Valerius formally converts the second displaced household's existing productive arrangement into regular tenant status within the estate's ordinary records. The stewards enter the household on the same tenant register used for other regular occupants, giving them clearly defined rights to use their assigned plot and the corresponding duties concerning cultivation, maintenance, and lawful use. The grant does not create a special exemption or a temporary charitable category; the household is now treated as a normal tenant household under the estate's established rules. Their earlier protection and assistance remain part of their history, but the new status marks a material change from protected displacement to ordinary participation in the estate's productive community. No additional land is transferred to them, and the estate's total landholding remains unchanged. No speculative rent is booked merely because regular tenant status has been granted; future settlements will be recorded only when payment is actually realized. The formal registration closes the household's transitional status and gives the arrangement a durable place in the estate administration.

background_sources.source: estate household correspondence and tenancy records
background_sources.basis: independent background administrative intelligence; not caused by the formal tenant registration

classification_audit.causal_basis: Directly caused by Valerius's explicit order to grant the new tenants regular tenant status.

events.title: THE PRINCIPAL ESTATE LAUNCHES THE NEW CAPITALIZATION NETWORK
events.body: Valerius's new trade order is put into practical operation through the principal estate, with the estate stewards assembling saleable surplus and identifying goods and inputs that can be improved or moved through the established merchant network. Skilled artisans attached to the estate and its foundries process part of the available material into more valuable finished goods, while merchants consolidate the completed lots for movement through the lake port and coordinate the acquisition of items needed for the next production cycle. The first completed capitalization cycle realizes 68 denarii in gross receipts against 27 denarii in processing, input, handling, packing, cartage, and lake-port costs, leaving 41 denarii of net public profit. The established routing rule transfers 4.1 denarii internally to Valerius's private account and retains 36.9 denarii publicly. The cost figure includes 9 denarii of needed-input purchases, 8 denarii of artisan processing, and 10 denarii of packing, cartage, and port handling, so the purchase of necessary materials is accounted for without being mistaken for revenue. The trade system is therefore no longer limited to the recurring surplus contract: saleable surplus, artisan-added value, and necessary commercial inputs are now being coordinated through the wider merchant and lake-port network. No future revenue is booked, and the trade metric remains at its capped 100 because the material expansion occurs in actual commercial throughput and realized capital rather than in a phantom increase to a bounded statistic.

background_sources.source: independent estate commercial correspondence and merchant intelligence
background_sources.basis: background commercial intelligence; not caused by the first capitalization cycle

ai_ledger.cost_basis: 27 denarii = 9 denarii needed-input purchases + 8 denarii artisan processing + 10 denarii packing, cartage, and lake-port handling.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Directly caused by Valerius's new standing trade-capitalization directive and its implementation through the established estate, artisan, merchant, and lake-port network.

events.title: THE RECURRING SURPLUS CONTRACT SETTLES AT A STRONGER WINTER MARGIN
events.body: The standing surplus-delivery agreement reaches another completed settlement as the merchants accept the current winter consignment through the shared-water road. The shipment realizes 54 denarii in gross receipts against 23 denarii in current harvesting, preparation, handling, and transport costs, leaving 31 denarii of realized net public profit. Under the canonical routing rule, 3.1 denarii is transferred internally to Valerius's private account and 27.9 denarii remains public. The consignment is valued from the quantities and conditions actually delivered during the week rather than copied from earlier settlements. The new capitalization mandate does not replace the contract's existing terms; instead, the recurring agreement continues as one distinct commercial channel within the wider estate trading system. No future delivery or receipt is booked beyond this realized settlement.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable material development of the established recurring commercial agreement, independently resolved from current winter conditions.

events.title: A LAKE-PORT MERCHANT HOUSE PLACES AN UNEXPECTED BULK ARTISAN ORDER
events.body: A merchant house operating through the lake port unexpectedly returns with a substantially larger order after examining the first finished goods being routed through the expanded commercial network. Rather than asking only for raw surplus, the merchants request a mixed batch of finished estate-made goods whose value depends on the skill of the artisans who prepared them, offering a price that makes the additional processing commercially worthwhile. The estate accepts the order without creating an exclusive privilege and sends the required material through the same established merchant services that have handled previous consignments. The completed sale realizes 35 denarii in gross receipts while artisan labor, preparation, packing, and transport cost 12 denarii, producing 23 denarii of net public profit. The established ten-percent routing sends 2.3 denarii to Valerius's private account and leaves 20.7 denarii publicly. The order is notable because it originates from outside the estate's established recurring contract and demonstrates that the lake-port merchant network can generate new demand for artisan-added goods rather than merely moving existing surplus. No future order value is booked, and no new permanent contract is assumed merely from the completed sale.

background_sources.basis: background commercial intelligence; not caused by the merchant's bulk order

classification_audit.causal_basis: Unexpected commercial demand emerging from established merchant and artisan circumstances; reviewed and preserved as Surprise because it is consequential but not extraordinary enough for Ultimate.

events.title: THE SECOND SILVER WORKING PRODUCES ANOTHER REALIZED COMMERCIAL LOT
events.body: The second silver working reaches another meaningful production threshold when a newly extracted lot from its confirmed working area is weighed, assayed, and accepted for sale. Lucius Atilius and Gnaeus Fabius keep the recorded material tied to the mapped working so that the productive result does not become a speculative statement about deeper reserves. The completed sale realizes 22 denarii in gross receipts against 8 denarii in extraction, sorting, assay, and handling costs, leaving 14 denarii of net public profit. The established ten-percent routing transfers 1.4 denarii privately and retains 12.6 denarii in the public account. The sale is a realized outcome from the mine rather than a valuation of unextracted silver, and no future yield is entered as current income. The mining operation therefore continues to move from measured working into repeatable commercial production while the extent of the remaining underground reserve stays unresolved.

background_sources.basis: independent background mining intelligence; not caused by this realized silver sale

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable material development of the established second-silver-working thread.

events.title: WINTER WATERLOGGING THREATENS PART OF THE SIX-ACRE FIELD
events.body: Heavy winter water leaves part of the six-acre parcel acquired earlier in the campaign standing too wet for the estate's established planting plan, and the condition is judged serious enough to require intervention rather than routine inspection. The agricultural stewards open an existing drainage line and clear the blocked section with estate labor, restoring the affected ground before standing water can damage the planted area. Five denarii in public funds are spent on the immediate labor, clearing, and materials needed for the repair, with no additional land purchased or transferred. Agriculture and infrastructure remain at their capped values, so the physical repair produces no phantom increase to either bounded metric. The second displaced household, now regular tenants, participates in the ordinary estate work associated with protecting its assigned productive land rather than receiving a separate exceptional payment. The repair prevents a larger loss but produces no realized agricultural revenue in itself. The parcel therefore remains part of the estate's productive cycle while its later yield continues to depend on the actual growing season.

background_sources.basis: independent background land and security intelligence; not caused by the drainage repair

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable material development of the established six-acre agricultural thread, with a concrete repair preventing unsupported crop-loss assumptions.

events.title: THE ESTATE'S NEW MEASUREMENT PRACTICE BECOMES THE STANDARD FOR COMMERCIAL HANDLING
events.body: The measurement method tested against the technical manuscript in Round 117 is adopted as a standard internal reference for weighing, sizing, and recording selected commercial lots handled by the estate. Lucius Marcius and Marcus Petronius attach the tested instructions to the estate's commercial records, while the artisans and carriers use the documented measurements when preparing containers and recording quantities for merchants. The adoption does not create a new technology statistic because the estate's technology measure is already capped, and it does not by itself realize income. Its significance is administrative and commercial: future consignments can now be compared using a common documented measurement procedure instead of relying entirely on individual workshop practice. The standard is added to the working records alongside the manuscript's provenance so that it can be reproduced consistently. No speculative savings or future profit is booked from the standard itself, but the estate's commercial accounting now has a more formal technical basis.

background_sources.basis: independent background scholarly intelligence; not caused by the adoption of the measurement standard

classification_audit.causal_basis: Established library thread reaching a material practical-administrative adoption threshold.

round_summary: Round 118 marks the opening of the election, the formal transition of the second displaced household into regular tenancy, and the first practical implementation of Valerius's expanded capitalization policy. Surplus, needed inputs, artisan-added goods, the existing recurring contract, lake-port commerce, and silver production all generated distinct developments, while quieter historical and household threads were allowed to remain in the background.
